content.title: Publish a default weekly slot
content.intent: Create and publish a dated slot in the preceptor's timezone with default duration, capacity, and all-linked visibility.
content.technique_notes: EQP valid class, state flow from planning to publication, timezone and defaults. Strength=3 from auth/data-loss; covering array on visibility [all linked,selected], duration [5,45,240], capacity [1,2,50] produced 18 combinations; the default representative all linked/45/1 is used here; selected is exercised separately. Uncovered valid cross-products are lower priority than distinct outcomes at the four-pair ceiling.
